! Game text
| Deploy on a site with “Waters” in game text. During your battle phase, if on [[Jabba's Palace: Rancor Pit{{!}}Rancor Pit]], may relocate a captive from [[Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber{{!}}Audience Chamber]] to here. If opponent's character here was just eaten, retrieve 3 Force. If a creature here is lost, owner loses Force equal to half its printed deploy cost (round up). Once per turn, if a creature here is about to draw destiny for ferocity, may instead use its destiny number. May {{Errata hl|1=use 1 Force to}} ▼ a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here. == Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Words a later column removed are highlighted in the column before it. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata 6)]] shares the [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata 5)]] column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
